description: This file defines the DesktopIconService class, which provides operations for managing desktop icons in the application, including listing, creating, updating, and deleting icons, with associated session validation.

classes.name: DesktopIconService
classes.description: Service providing operations for managing desktop icons.

methods.name: listIconsForSession
methods.description: Lists all icons for a given session by session ID. Throws ResourceNotFoundException if session does not exist.

methods.name: createIcon
methods.description: Creates a new desktop icon within a specified session, throwing an exception if the session is not found.

methods.name: updateIcon
methods.description: Updates an existing icon, ensuring it belongs to the specified session; throws exception if not found or mismatch.

methods.name: deleteIcon
methods.description: Deletes an icon from a session, ensuring it belongs to the session; throws exception if not found.

methods.name: ensureSessionExists
methods.description: Private helper to verify if a session exists; throws exception if not.

methods.name: toDto
methods.description: Converts a DesktopIcon entity to a DesktopIconDto.
